transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light gardening after 1 week. Just avoid heavy exercise or heavy lifting for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I'm also experiencing sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Mild sensitivity to bright light can be normal while your eyes adjust. If things just seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But significant pain in bright light, or very strong light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful. If that’s happening, it may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the advice. My final question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If it is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, it may need checking to make sure it’s okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: If you have any other concerns or questions in the future, feel free to reach out. Take care and have a good day!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
